name: chromeos-webdav-fsp
description: Mount a WebDAV share in the ChromeOS Files app via chrome.fileSystemProvider

scripts.check: node --check extension/dav.js && node --check extension/auth.js && node --check extension/config.js && node --check extension/background.js && node --check extension/options.js && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('extension/manifest.json','utf8'))"
